summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PAGINA DEL LINK application. Backend API testing achieved 88.9% success rate (8/9 tests passed). Frontend UI testing was fully successful with all core features working correctly. The application successfully handles link submissions, prohibited content filtering, favicon extraction, admin approval workflow, and displays approved links in a responsive grid layout.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 422 instead of 400 for validation errors
minor_issues.impact: Very minor - 422 is actually the correct HTTP status for validation errors in FastAPI
minor_issues.note: This is not actually a bug, just a test expectation mismatch
